items.scope: Audit findings 21 to 24: margins added to the 16px gap, full-width Backlog and Prototype pages, title attribute on page titles and subtitles, .ds-text-* classes. Decisions asked first: full-width pages, text styles of section titles and captions. Also audit finding 32 (B123): the token tables of the Design preview and Playground scroll horizontally and clip the Select list; decision asked first: stop the horizontal scroll so the list opens over the page.
doneWhen: Blocks are 16px apart on every page.
Every page title and subtitle has its title attribute.
Text uses the text styles, applied with their 4 tokens (page-header skill).
The next compliance audit no longer lists these findings.

items.title: Agents: audit proposes tickets, fix agent implements them
items.description: ds-compliance-audit proposes the tickets from its findings; a second agent, ds-compliance-fix, implements a validated ticket on the documentation site.
items.why: The audit findings become tickets without manual sorting, and the approved fixes are carried out by a dedicated agent; the next audit checks its work.
items.scope: Proposed tickets section in the audit report; new agent .claude/agents/ds-compliance-fix.md allowed to change docs/ only (tokens/, components/ and prototypes/ stay forbidden to agents); rules in CLAUDE.md, git-workflow and orchestrator.
doneWhen: The audit report ends with proposed tickets, shown in the chat and created only once the Design System Lead agrees.
ds-compliance-fix implements a validated ticket in docs/ only, after the Design System Lead answered its decisions; Claude checks it and gives the preview before any commit.

items.title: Agents page
items.description: An Agents page in Governance that documents every agent of the project.
items.why: Agents now exist in .claude/agents/ (ds-compliance-audit, ds-compliance-fix) and more are planned (B084, B120), but the documentation site does not show them.
items.scope: A page in Governance, like How to use skills, that reads .claude/agents/ and shows each agent: its role, when it is run, its allowed tools and what it reports; plus the rules shared by all agents (read and propose only, result checked by Claude). Not included: a skill on how to create an agent.
doneWhen: The Agents page lists every agent of .claude/agents/, read from the files (a new agent appears without changing the page).
Each agent shows its role, when it is run, its allowed tools and what it reports.
The page shows the rules shared by all agents.

items.title: UX playground: compose components in a layout
items.description: A space of the documentation site where UX designers combine the coded components in a layout, like FigJam, before a prototype or development.
items.why: Today, testing a combination of components means writing a prototype in code. UX designers need a quick way to explore an idea on their own, with real components, before it becomes a prototype or goes to development.
items.scope: Included: only the coded components (@ds/components) and the tokens, so every composition can be built as is; a composition can be the starting point of a prototype ticket; a missing component found while composing is a signal for the backlog. Different from the playground.tsx of each component (one component, its props): here several components are combined. Decisions asked first: how to compose (free canvas like FigJam, the design system grid 4 / 8 / 12 columns, or a canvas with layout frames); whether the variants, states and texts of each placed component can be changed; how compositions are saved (not saved, in the browser, or in the repository and shared); whether a composition can become a prototype ticket; annotations (sticky notes, comments); where it sits in the navigation (a new space next to Prototypes, or a page under Prototypes).

items.title: Git workflow: project branches for long pieces of work
items.description: A new branch type, project/<name>, for long pieces of work on the documentation site, each with its own conversation.
items.why: Governance branches are very short and merged as soon as a step is approved; a large piece of work like the UX playground (B130) needs its own long branch, merged once it is validated.
items.scope: Included: the project/<name> branch type (kebab-case, long lifetime, merged into develop once the project is validated or on request) and its conversation Projet <Name>, archived at the end, in git-workflow, CLAUDE.md and the Git workflow page of the site; then governance/ux-playground renamed project/ux-playground and B130 updated. Not included: the work of the UX playground itself (B130).

items.title: Documentation site: accessibility follow-up
items.description: Markdown code blocks scroll inside their own box; the brand fill of a checked control is checked for contrast.
items.why: Found by the full compliance audit before the merge into develop (audits/2026-10-30-before-develop-merge.md).
items.scope: Audit findings 42 and 43: Markdown code blocks of the Skills and Agents cards (and any Markdown) overflow the card; the pair background.brand on background.page (checkbox fill, pressed toggle) is not in tokens/contrast-pairs.json. Decisions asked first: same look as pre.code (surface background, padding) or scroll only; background.brand or border.focus for a checked control fill.
doneWhen: Long code lines in Markdown scroll inside their block and never overflow the card.
The brand fill pair is in contrast-pairs.json and npm run tokens passes.
The next compliance audit no longer lists findings 42 and 43.

items.title: Documentation site: landing page layout
items.description: The landing page and the prototypes list follow the layout rules, or get an approved exception.
items.why: Found by the full compliance audit before the merge into develop (audits/2026-10-30-before-develop-merge.md).
items.scope: Audit finding 44: side margin 16px instead of 24px, 8px between the title and the subtitle, 24px between the panel and the cards (docs/src/docs.css .home, .home-panel h1, .home-links; also used by prototypes/list.tsx). Decision asked first: do the layout rules apply to the Level 0 landing page and /prototypes/, or is it a site exception?
doneWhen: The landing page and the prototypes list follow the layout rules, or the exception is written in the layout skill.
The next compliance audit no longer lists finding 44.

items.title: Documentation site: text alternative of the git workflow diagram
items.description: Make the branch types and their merge rules of the Git workflow diagram available to screen readers.
items.why: Found by the design system compliance audit (audits/2026-10-30-B131-1.md, finding 27): the Organization diagram has role="img", so screen readers do not read its branch list, and its aria-label does not name the branch types or when each one is merged (WCAG 1.1.1, 1.3.1).
items.scope: The Organization diagram of the Git workflow page (docs/src/pages/GitWorkflowPage.tsx). Asked first: keep role="img" with a full description, or show the list to screen readers.
doneWhen: A screen reader reads every branch type of the diagram and when it is merged.
The next compliance audit no longer lists finding 27.
